purpose: Teach: 入園/ミニマム/コンソーシアム/原本/諸般/目途/休刊/乗り出す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究員の子の入園もお祝いしろ
lines.en: Ren—make sure you congratulate the research team member on their child's enrollment.
lines.style: Calm, measured directive. Voice carries both instruction and quiet approval. Leans back slightly. The tone of someone who expects the action without needing to emphasize it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験はミニマムな試料で進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll proceed with minimal sample sizes for the experiments.
lines.style: Respectful but not obsequious. Clear and direct. A slight nod forward in the voice—acknowledging instruction, showing readiness. Steady eye contact in tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、国際研究コンソーシアムに参加しろ
lines.style: Brief, authoritative. No softening. The weight of expectation in the opening word. Deliberate pause between his name and the instruction. Not unkind, but unmistakably a command.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の原本は研究室で保管します
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep the original manuscripts secured in the lab.
lines.style: Quick acceptance, slightly anticipatory. He's already thinking ahead—nodding to the next logical step before being asked. Efficient in delivery, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、諸般の事情がある研究員にも配慮しろ
lines.en: Ren—look out for the team members dealing with difficult circumstances.
lines.style: Subtly softer than the previous directives. Still authoritative, but the vocal weight shifts—this is about people, not procedures. A beat of emphasis on 「配慮」 in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文提出の目途を立てております
lines.en: Yes. I've already set a timeline for the paper submission.
lines.style: Formal and composed. A touch of quiet pride—he's thought this through. Measured pacing. The assurance of someone prepared before being asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、業界誌の休刊にも目を配れ
lines.en: Ren—stay aware of the changes in the industry publications.
lines.style: The tone of someone sharing a lesson, not just issuing orders. A slight emphasis on the broader context. Patient. The voice of a mentor who reads the long game.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新研究分野に乗り出す覚悟です
lines.en: Yes. I'm ready to move into new research areas.
lines.style: Stronger closure than before. Conviction underneath. Not boastful, but the voice of someone who has made an internal decision and is stating it as fact. A slight lift at the end.
